tasks.title: Own SQLite transactions and connection lifetimes on native and web
tasks.description: Reserve whole transactions so unrelated app or browser-tab SQL cannot enter their commit or rollback. Fence retained facades after owner retirement. This is the prerequisite for RF104's single-generation tafsir replacement.
tasks.rationale: The SDK's ambient transaction API and current web BEGIN/COMMIT RPC wrapper permit interleaved callers. Private connection ownership must cover complete SQL operations, scoped transactions and teardown. Current SQL values, content and account-data policies stay intact.
acceptance_criteria: Expose DatabaseExecutor with four SQL methods and real array/named/variadic overloads. AppDatabase adds withTransactionAsync(callback(TransactionDatabase)); TransactionDatabase adds minimal prepared execute/finalize. All nine existing callbacks and complete helper trees use their supplied scope. Keep stable facade identity. No full SDK facade cast, nested transaction API or unrelated SQL/value/schema/content/account-policy change.

One private FIFO covers whole ordinary prepare/execute/read/finalize and whole transactions; scoped operations bypass it through an internal FIFO. Callback settlement seals new admission, drains accepted/caught/unawaited operations, finalizes remaining handles, then commits or rolls back. The first scoped SQL failure poisons the transaction even after remote commit admission. Ordinary nontransaction SQL errors recover. Explicit finalize closes at admission while earlier queued executes still run; retained scopes/commands reject after sealing. Do not retain completed statements indefinitely.

Preserve the original sole error and additional cleanup errors without mutating frozen errors or unsupported runtime APIs. Quarantine on ambiguous raw BEGIN rejection, rejecting queued/new SQL without callback or replay; close the private handle after drain. COMMIT failure attempts one rollback; uncertain finalize/rollback quarantines. Close retires synchronously, caches its promise and closes raw once even on failure. Provider native/web opens useNewConnection:true with existing file, foreign-key and WAL behavior.

Version discovery/request/response. Ignore legacy SQL before execution, including old bare BEGIN. Reservations bind client identity, nonce and fresh host generation/token. Register BEGIN's60s deadline on receipt, cancel by nonce before admission and recheck immediately before raw BEGIN. Remote idle lease60s, heartbeat15s, valid SQL renews. SQL/heartbeat/commit synchronously require an unexpired deadline before renewal or admission; timers check identity/current deadline. Late controls cannot revive. Authored exec SQL remains privileged; no keyword firewall.

Commit synchronously switches active to committing, seals new host operations and joins actual owner drain/COMMIT. Expiry/retirement directly abort pending/active reservations before any teardown wait; committing joins actual outcome without concurrent rollback. Owner poison after drain remains authoritative. ACK loss is unknown and never replayed. Client local FIFO covers ordinary RPC and whole callback; scoped FIFO/virtual prepared commands use the reservation. Seal new SQL then drain with internal heartbeat until settlement admission. Retirement or heartbeat failure races callback wait, rejects pending work and cancels nonce before disconnect. Ordinary RPC behind another peer's long transaction may still time out after60s. Cleanup uses an explicit private owner settlement outcome, independently of work errors. Cleanup-only receipts are bounded to 64 entries and 60 seconds, join held rollback/commit, and report unknown after eviction/expiry; failed rollback never acknowledges cleanup success.

Provider synchronously retires every old/opening owner and directly aborts remote reservations before awaiting old init/RPC. Late opens are wrapped/stored and immediately retired when obsolete, without initialization. Once-only fatal notification is nonblocking/nonthrowing and checks live epoch plus resource membership during bootstrap; use existing retire/error/recovery flow. Preserve detached void runInit restart, the stronger VFS cleanupFailure barrier, lock release only after confirmed close and effect-local failed-close quarantine.

Use actual isolated SQLite tests for ordinary recovery, whole-operation/read/finalize drain, caught/unawaited errors, retained scope/commands, executes queued before finalize, BEGIN executed then rejected, cleanup/rollback quarantine and close once. Add actual owner-backed QF pull/queue integration to expose outer-facade self-deadlock. Existing caller fixtures must pass a scope and retain meaningful ownership assertions; do not bulk-wrap old ambient-write barriers into a deadlock.

Provider/protocol tests cover bootstrap fatal, active reservation teardown, commit/retire, late-open hide/show, stale/repeated fatal, failed close, pending BEGIN cancellation, expired messages before timer, renewed stale timers and unawaited SQL failure after commit admission. Actual Chrome proves two-peer transaction rollback isolation, version rejection, fresh host handoff and real lease expiry.
